title: *Last min special!* Walk to Vandy!
description:
Nestled in a prime location walking distance to Centennial Park and local restaurants, this updated cottage basement apartment offers the perfect retreat with quick access to Vanderbilt.

Inside, you will find a bright, inviting interior featuring timber floors, unique artwork, and thoughtful design touches that make you feel right at home. There is a fully equipped, full-size kitchen.

There are two bedrooms, one with a king bed, the second has a twin bed with a pull out, twin trundle.

The space
This is an adorable, renovated, downstairs, private apartment that is small, but comfortable.   One bedroom has a King sized bed and the second bedroom has a twin bed and a trundle twin bed. There is a full kitchen and small living space.  There is a common laundry space available for use.  Great outdoor living space for relaxing!

Guest access
You can check in anytime on your own.  There is a digital lock keypad on the  entry door.

Other things to note
Please note that the twin bed + twin trundle room doesn’t have a door and when the trundle is pulled out the beds are wall to wall.
